about: Atlas pages load in the background (sprite_add_ext). While one is loading its frames still pass the bounds check (size from the PNG header) and a bake still gets its pixels; a page deleted while loading, alone or with every runtime sprite, leaves nothing behind.

steps.name: gnx_scn_atlas_bake_same
steps.why: the bake holds the page's pixels, not an empty rectangle
